name: task
title: 任务 API
description: 任务、清单、子任务、任务智能体

summary.description: Task summary. Empty is not allowed; support up to 3000 utf8 characters

timestamp.description: The timestamp of the due time/date in milliseconds from 1970-01-01 00:00:00. If the expiration time is a date, you need to convert the date to timestamp and set is_all_day = true

is_all_day.description: Whether to due on a date. If set to true, only the date part of the timestamp will be parsed and stored

origin.description: Origin information of the third-party platform associated with the task. Once set during creation, it cannot be changed

platform_i18n_name.description: The name of the task import source, used for display on the task center details page. Multiple language versions need to be provided

href.description: Link to the source platform detail page associated with the task

members.description: A list of task members, including assignees and followers. If not filled in, the task has no members. Support up to 50 members per request after de-duplication.; Please refer to the " How to represent members of tasks and tasklists?" section in [Feature Overview](https://open.feishu.cn/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/task-v2/tasklist/overview)

role.description: Member roles, which can be "assignee" or "follower"

timestamp.description: The timestamp of the start time/date in milliseconds from 1970-01-01 00:00:00. If the start time is a date, you need to convert the date to timestamp and set is_all_day = true

is_all_day.description: Whether to start on a date. If set to true, only the date part of the timestamp will be parsed and stored

mode.description: Task completion mode, 1: countersign tasks; 2: or-sign tasks

custom_fields.description: Custom field values. One or multiple custom fields values can be set at the same time as the tasks are created. The custom field to set the values must be associated with the tasklists to which the task is added (which is specified be `tasklist`), otherwise it cannot be set.; The value needs to be set to the corresponding field according to the field type.;* When `type` is "number", the `number_value` field should be used to represent the value of number custom field; * When "type" is "member", the `member_value` field should be used to represent the value of member custom field; * When `type` is "datetime", `datetime_value` field should be used to represent the value of the datetime custom field.;* When `type` is "single_select", the `single_select_value` field should be used to represent the value of single_select custom field.;* When `type` is "multi_select", the `multi_select_value` field should be used to represent the value of multi_select custom field

token.description: The document token associated with the task, requiring: if using tenant_access_token request, the request robot has document editing permission; if using user_access_token, the request user has document editing permission

block_id.description: The document associated with the task block_id, requiring block_id to exist in the document corresponding to the token, and block_id not bound to other tasks

type.description: Custom field types, support five types: "member", "datetime", "number", "single_select", and "multi_select"

number_value.description: The value of a custom field of number type is filled with a string representation of a legal number. An empty string indicates setting it to null

datetime_value.description: Datetime value for custom fields of date type. A string in milliseconds representing a date can be entered. Setting an empty string indicates setting it to null

member_value.description: The custom field value of member type can set the ids of one or more users (following the member format and only supporting user type). When the setting of this field is "cannot be multi-selected", only one value can be entered. Setting it as an empty array means setting it to empty

single_select_value.description: Single-select value field. Fill in the option_guid of one field option. Setting an empty string means setting it to empty

multi_select_value.description: For multi-select type field values, one or more option_guids of this field can be filled. Setting it as an empty array indicates setting it as empty

text_value.description: Text value field. You can enter a piece of text. An empty string indicates clearing
